Very worst hotel….We regret booking this hotel. Within just hours of checking in, the reality turned out to be completely different from what we were shown. The room looked fine at first glance, but soon we noticed dirty bedsheets, poor hygiene, and a foul smell. The bathroom was not properly cleaned, and the facilities promised were either missing or non-functional. The staff seemed careless and unhelpful when we raised concerns. Honestly, this was one of the worst stays we’ve ever had – definitely not worth the money or the trouble
